summary: Frontend-only verification of the dynamic 'today' fix in Class Cue. Tested topbar eyebrow label, Calendar week/month views, prev/Today navigation, Add class default date, June 2026 demo-session regression, dashboard render, and console errors. Browser date at test time: 2026-08-28 (Friday). All 7 requested checks PASSED with no console errors.

issues: Day cells have fixed height so a 3rd event in the same day (June 16 2026: 11:00 Science) is visually clipped/overflowing with no '+N more' indicator
Greeting is hardcoded to 'Good morning, Alex' irrespective of the actual time of day - inconsistent with the newly dynamic date banner

action_items: Optional: make dashboard greeting time-aware (morning/afternoon/evening) for consistency with the now-dynamic date label
Optional: month-view cell overflow handling ('+N more') for days with 3+ sessions
critical_code_review_comments: Dead code: CalendarV2 (hardcoded June 2026 dateMap, non-functional prev/next/today buttons) is still present in App.js and unused - delete it to avoid future confusion
App.js packs whole components onto single 1000+ char lines; readability/maintainability is poor and should be split into modules
`today` in CalendarV3 is recomputed on every render (not memoized); harmless today but will not roll over at midnight and creates a new Date object per render - consider useMemo
seed_data_creation: None created this run. Note: localStorage from earlier iterations contains a leftover 'Test Class' session on 2026-06-18 which appears in the June 2026 calendar and as the dashboard What's Next card.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified dynamic date fix: topbar-today-label matched new Date() exactly ('FRIDAY · AUG 28, 2026'); week kicker 'AUGUST 23 — 29, 2026' with exactly one selected-day cell (Fri 28); prev-week removed the highlight and today-calendar-button restored it; month kicker 'AUGUST 2026' with selected cell number 28; add-class-button date input defaulted to 2026-08-28. Demo sessions ses-1/2/3 still render when navigating to JUNE 2026. Note the add-class default uses iso(cursor) (not strictly today), so if the user navigates away first the default is the visible period date - acceptable/arguably better UX.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - fix verified working. Previously hardcoded '2026-06-16' now derived from new Date() in both App topbar and CalendarV3.
